# Decisions

<!-- portable-kb:index:start -->
* [Pin OKF v0.2 for the core profile](pin-okf-v02.md) - The core profile targets one immutable OKF v0.2 revision and reviews upstream changes explicitly.
* [Separate the core from consumers](separate-core-from-consumers.md) - Search, embeddings, CLI, MCP, UI, and authorization remain consumers outside the canonical core.
